_comment: Template for a long unattended run. Copy, edit, then:
Write checks that name a TEST or a build, not a doc marker, wherever you can.
A doc marker is a file the agent edits; a failing test is a fact about the
code. The queue-marker check below is the weakest one here on purpose — it is
what makes the run END, and it is worth knowing that it is also the one an
agent could satisfy by editing a checkbox.
`deadline_utc` is not optional in spirit: it is what makes 24 hours mean
